title: The Miseducation Of Lauryn Hill
notes:
Release is packaged in a clear jewel case with a clear disc tray. Includes a 16-page booklet with lyrics and a back cover inlay.

This is a Pitman pressing with the manufacturing code on the label. [r=6539464] is also a Pitman pressing but without the mould stamp. [r=244851] is not a Pitman pressing, and does not have the manufacturing code on the label.

© 1998 Ruffhouse Records LP/℗ 1998 Ruffhouse Records LP.

Track 15 and 16 are unlisted bonus tracks.
